summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a 6-K confirming open-market repurchases of 285,000 ordinary shares on US venues and 118,748 shares on London venues between 7 and 11 September 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, Goldman Sachs International or affiliates at volume-weighted averages ranging from roughly GBP 76.52 to GBP 78.79 and USD 102.94 to USD 106.82. The purchases fall under the buyback programme announced 17 February 2026, targeting up to EUR 1 billion in aggregate, with repurchased shares cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor opinion is cited beyond the broker mandate. Watch execution pace against the EUR 1 billion cap and any tender-offer or going-private pivot.
